notes: Five own pages read, all HTTP 200 and not thin; one cited page read for a cause. The pricing page lists the Sales Cloud suites as Starter Suite ($25, billed monthly or annually), Pro Suite ($100, billed annually), Core ($195), Advanced ($395) and Max ($550, all billed annually) plus a Free Suite at $0 in the comparison table; its edition check marks are images, so feature-by-edition rows (territories, forecasting) cannot be read from the snapshot. Edition names: the pages still refer to Professional Edition and Unlimited Edition, and no page read (pricing, product, products, newsroom) documents a dated retirement of Enterprise, Unlimited or Essentials; claims naming those editions are therefore unverifiable rather than stale. One cited third-party page (brokenrubik.com, read for HubSpot) says Salesforce replaced Enterprise/Unlimited with Core/Advanced/Max on 3 September 2026; it was not used to class. Names: Salesforce, Sales Cloud and Salesforce CRM are the vendor's names and were not coded; feature names (Pipeline Inspection, Agent Builder) were treated as capabilities. Stack advice such as pairing Salesforce with Outreach, Salesloft, Gong or Cleanlist (crm|8|Claude|1 and 2) was read as advice, not an integration claim. C04 is wrong against the published $25 USD Starter price; the cited startups.co.uk page gives 20 pounds for Starter Suite (its snapshot keeps the entity £ as text), which the answer appears to restate in dollars. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser snapshot exists for this vendor; C10 stays unverifiable because the edition marks are images in the only read, and the other unverifiable claims are not about a blocked or thin page. Added C30 (five Starter Suite users at about $100 a month, wrong, cause not found) from crm|5|Google AI Overviews|1. The other gap lines are generic integration or ecosystem lines, hedged, or about other vendors; the one table with Salesforce as a column header (crm|7|Claude|2) and the plain comparison tables (crm|7|Google AI Mode|1, crm|7|Google AI Overviews|3) only repeat the Einstein name their answers already carry in C17, and the 'Starting Price: Varies' cell in crm|5|Claude|2 states no fact. Consistency check: C04 stays wrong (see its rationale).
